Narrow practical nautical equipment; original angular broken-keel insignia (a simple split V-shaped keel, not an anchor). No bright blue sails, round glass ornaments or generic pirate skulls.

Narrow auburn patched sailcloth hangs to the right, with petrol inset and a large simple dull-brass broken-keel mark. Static still cloth, grouped coarse folds, no wind trails. Full pole, cloth and foot fit central70%; 64x64 logical detail.
